newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close firmer in selective trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close firmer in selective trade.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed firmer on Monday as interest for selected stocks after a stronger start on Wall Street pressured prices upwards, dealers said.
The general index added 1.96 points, 0.39 percent, to 501.17 and the Ibex-35 rose 24.72 points, 0.43 percent, to 5,757.31.
Repsol fell 70 pesetas to 6,010 at the end of privatisation, with the final price for the offering due after Wall Street closes.
Banesto rose 85 pesetas to 1,320 on bright prospects at the end of a restructuring period, dealers said.
Other banks were flat to lower after hefty recent gains.
Banco Popular shed 200 pesetas to 30,600 after soaring on an announced buyback last week.
Volume was lower than in previous sessions at 54.8 billion pesetas, as dealers eyed a two-day public holiday on Thursday and Friday. Aside from specific rises the session was fairly lacklustre.
"It's been pretty dull really, although towards the close we saw more money, and the rest of the week doesn't seem likely to bring many changes because of the fiestas," said a Mercavalor trader.
